  {"step":10,"file":"src/psl.c","function":"psl_load_fp","line":1315,"var":"suffixp","code":"suffixp->label = suffixp->label_buf; add_punycode_if_needed(idna, psl->suffixes, suffixp);","note":"The converted punycode result is retained in the suffix entry, making the write reachable during PSL loading."}
